entries.title: No one-click unsubscribe? It's spam.
entries.author: cpursley
entries.excerpt: Your marking emails might not have a one-click unsubscribe link but Gmail certainly has a one click spam button. Two ways you can keep me as a subscriber: 1. Remind me what the hell it is your company does/sells in the first sentence. Between my signup and now, chances are about 95% that I forgot what I even signed up for. 2. Make it easy to unsubscribe.
